digest.component_or_area: completion banking test oracle (0707 live eval)
propositions: The test oracle _bounded_bank_gaps measures executed filesystem-tool calls instead of evidence responses, decoupling from the policy's actual enforcement boundary (max_evidence_responses=3) after commit dd41 changed suppression behavior.

Commit dd41 allows batched EVIDENCE calls to execute instead of being suppressed, causing a batching model to execute ~11 reads within <=2 evidence responses, making the executed-call bound structurally unsatisfiable.

The 0707 test must be re-denominated to measure evidence responses (distinct run_steps) rather than executed calls, preserving the safety intent of incremental banking with bounded gaps while accepting dd41-intended batched execution.

The measurement seam monkeypatches wrap_completion_evidence_policy to install a counting toolset that records distinct run_steps for executed evidence tools, excluding steered notices, and observers snapshot evidence-response counts at each criterion's first write.

Unit regression test_completion_banking_oracle.py drives the shared oracle helpers through real wrap_completion_evidence_policy transcripts, rejecting zero-bank exhaustion and first-bank-after-3-responses defects while accepting batched execution shapes.

Post-merge live run 32575679530 exposed model-voluntary-cadence vs system-level-boundedness fork, resolved by ticket 6543-24a7-d2fb-4ff9's re-scope to count durable banks (genuine and fallback) rather than genuine-only.
